{{nihongo|'''Kannabi Shrine (Fuchu city, Hiroshima)'''|甘南備神社}} is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945}} in Deguchi-cho, {{ill|Fuchū, Hiroshima|ar|فوجو (هيروشيما)|azb|فوجو، هیروشیما|ca|Fuchū|ce|Футю (гӀала, Хиросима)|ceb|Fuchū-shi (distrito sa Hapon, Hiroshima-ken)|cs|Fučú (Hirošima)|de|Fuchū (Hiroshima)|eo|Fuchū (Hiroŝimo)|es|Fuchū (Hiroshima)|fa|فوجو، هیروشیما|fi|Fuchū (Hiroshima)|fr|Fuchū (Hiroshima)|gl|Fuchū, Hiroshima|id|Fuchu, Hiroshima (kota)|it|Fuchū (Hiroshima)|ja|府中市 (広島県)|ko|후추시 (히로시마현)|ms|Fuchū, Hiroshima (bandar)|mzn|فوجو، هیروشیما|nl|Fuchu (Hiroshima)|pl|Fuchū (Hiroszima)|pt|Fuchū (Hiroshima)|ro|Fuchū, Hiroshima|ru|Футю (город, Хиросима)|sv|Fuchū, Hiroshima|tg|Фучу, Ҳирошима|th|ฟูจู (นครในจังหวัดฮิโรชิมะ)|tl|Fuchū, Hiroshima|tr|Fuchū, Hiroşima|tt|Футю (шәһәр, Хиросима)|uk|Футю (Хіросіма, Бінґо)|ur|فوچو، ہیروشیما|vi|Fuchū, Hiroshima|war|Fuchū, Hiroshima|zh|府中市 (廣島縣)|zh_classical|府中市 (廣島縣)|zh_min_nan|Hutyû-chhī (Hirosima)|zh_yue|府中市 (廣島)|qid=Q686775|lt=Fuchu}}, {{ill|Hiroshima Prefecture|Q617375|qid=Q617375}}. It is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}}, and its former rank under the {{ill|Q712534|lt=modern shrine ranking system}} was {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Prefectural Shrine}}. {{nihongo|'''Kannabi Shrine (Fuchu city, Hiroshima)'''|甘南備神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Bingo Province]].

== Overview ==
In {{ill|708|Q23511|qid=Q23511}} (Wado 1), when an epidemic spread, Saeki Sukune Maro, then provincial governor of {{ill|Bingo Province|Q1049113|qid=Q1049113}}, is said to have invited a divided spirit of {{ill|Kotoshironushi-no-Mikoto|lt=Kotoshironushi-no-Mikoto|UNKNOWN|qid=Q8009611|lt=Kotoshironushi-no-Mikoto}} from {{ill|Miho Shrine|Q3313076|qid=Q3313076}} in {{ill|Izumo Province|Q582846|qid=Q582846}}. The epidemic was driven away through prayer, and in gratitude {{ill|Ōkuninushi|qid=Q276944|lt=Okuninushi-no-Kami}} and {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Sukunahikona-no-Kami}} were additionally enshrined. The shrine gained reverence from officials of the {{ill|Bingo Provincial Capital|Q28682318|qid=Q28682318}}, rose in status, and on {{ill|878|Q23910|qid=Q23910}} ({{ill|Gangyō|Q747451|qid=Q747451}} 2), received promotion from Emperor {{ill|Emperor Yōzei|Q349280|qid=Q349280}} to "Senior Fifth Rank Upper," the highest in Bingo Province. Its name also appears in the Ashida District section of the ''{{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932}}''.

Because this shrine stands on an ancient transport route linking Sanyo and San'in, it is said that people enshrined an Izumo-lineage deity here in contrast to the Kibi-lineage Nangu Shrine (Kurikara-cho, Fuchu, Hiroshima)<ref>Shigeru Morimoto, 1995, p. 250</ref>.

* {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Sukunahikona-no-Kami}}

== History ==
* {{ill|708 in Japan|Q56346742|qid=Q56346742|lt=708}} (Wado 1) - Founded.
* {{ill|723 in Japan|Q56347391|qid=Q56347391|lt=723}} (Yoro 7) - Relocated and merged here from {{ill|Fujio|Q11623827|qid=Q11623827|lt=Fujio Village}} following an oracle of the Ryuo deity.
* {{ill|760|Q30552|qid=Q30552}} ({{ill|Tenpyō-hōji|Q1346307|qid=Q1346307}} 4) - During an epidemic, provincial governor Kannabi Mahito Ika prayed and received divine efficacy; granted Junior Fifth Rank Upper.
* {{ill|867|Q30347|qid=Q30347}} ({{ill|Jōgan|Q1075635|qid=Q1075635|lt=Jogan}} 9, 4th month, 8th day) - Promoted by Emperor {{ill|Emperor Seiwa|Q349243|qid=Q349243}} from Bingo Junior Fifth Rank Upper to Senior Fifth Rank Lower.
* {{ill|878|Q23910|qid=Q23910}} (Genkei 2, 11th month, 13th day) - Promoted by Emperor {{ill|Emperor Yōzei|Q349280|qid=Q349280}} from Bingo Senior Fifth Rank Lower to Senior Fifth Rank Upper.
* {{ill|1558|Q6601|qid=Q6601}} ({{ill|Eiroku|Q1143341|qid=Q1143341}} 1) - In a great drought, {{ill|Mōri Motonari|Q1156545|qid=Q1156545}} offered rain-prayer thanks and donated one cho of rice field in perpetuity.
* {{ill|1638|Q6893|qid=Q6893}} ({{ill|Kan'ei|Q1192913|qid=Q1192913}} 15) - {{ill|Mizuno Katsushige|Q8190277|qid=Q8190277}} performed rain-prayer thanks and donated one parcel of field for offerings.
* {{ill|1703|Q6822|qid=Q6822}} ({{ill|Genroku|Q1325001|qid=Q1325001}} 16) - Subsidiary Ryuo Shrine built.
* {{ill|1706|Q6835|qid=Q6835}} ({{ill|Hōei|Q1145262|qid=Q1145262}} 3, 8th month) - Lord {{ill|Matsudaira Tadamasa|Q11239123|qid=Q11239123}} of {{ill|Fukuyama Domain|Q909278|qid=Q909278}} built the main hall.
* {{ill|1734|Q6977|qid=Q6977}} ({{ill|Kyōhō|Q1145048|qid=Q1145048}} 19, 6th month) - Haiden built.
* {{ill|1764|Q7659|qid=Q7659}} ({{ill|Meiwa|Q1146161|qid=Q1146161}} 1, 5th-9th months) - Main hall roof rethatched.
* {{ill|1789|Q7772|qid=Q7772}} ({{ill|Kansei|Q1195131|qid=Q1195131}} 1) - Repairs.
* {{ill|1866|Q7712|qid=Q7712}} (Keio 2, 4th month, 8th day) - 1000th anniversary festival of Seiwa Emperor's rank grant held.
* {{ill|1872|Q7753|qid=Q7753}} ({{ill|Meiji era|ar|فترة مييجي|ast|Dómina Meiji|az|Meydzi dövrü|azb|مئی‌جی دؤورو|be|Перыяд Мэйдзі|bn|মেইজি যুগ|bo|མེའི་ཇིའི་དུས་དུས་མཚམས།|ca|Era Meiji|cs|Období Meidži|da|Meiji-perioden|de|Meiji-Zeit|el|Μεϊτζί (περίοδος)|es|Era Meiji|et|Meiji periood|eu|Meiji Aroa|fa|دوره میجی|fi|Meiji-kausi|fr|Ère Meiji|gl|Período Meiji|he|תקופת מייג'י|hr|Meiji (razdoblje)|ht|Epòk Meiji|hu|Meidzsi-kor|id|Zaman Meiji|io|Ero Meiji|is|Meiji-tímabilið|it|Periodo Meiji|ja|明治|ka|მეიძის ეპოქა|kbp|Mejii wɛɛ yaa alɩwaatʊ|kk|Мэйдзи дәуірі|ko|메이지 시대|la|Aetas Meiji|lt|Meidži laikotarpis|lv|Meidzi periods|mk|Меиџи (период)|mn|Мэйжийн эрин|ms|Zaman Meiji|nl|Meijiperiode|nn|Meiji|no|Meiji-perioden|pl|Meiji (okres)|pt|Era Meiji|ro|Perioada Meiji|ru|Мэйдзи|simple|Meiji period|sk|Obdobie Meidži|sq|Periudha Meixhi|sr|Меиџи период|sv|Meijiperioden|ta|மெய்சி காலம்|th|ยุคเมจิ|tl|Panahong Meiji|tr|Meiji Dönemi|uk|Період Мейдзі|ur|میجی دور|vi|Thời kỳ Minh Trị|war|Panahon Meiji|wuu|明治|zh|明治|zh_classical|明治|zh_min_nan|Bêng-tī|zh_yue|明治|qid=Q3125096}} 5) - Promoted to gosha.
* {{ill|1878|Q7776|qid=Q7776}} (Meiji 11), Dec 17 - 1000th anniversary festival of Yozei Emperor's rank grant held.
* {{ill|1924|Q2173|qid=Q2173}} ({{ill|Taishō era|ar|فترة تايشو|br|Oadvezh Taishō|ca|Període Taishō|cs|Období Taišó|de|Taishō-Zeit|eo|Taiŝo-epoko|es|Era Taishō|et|Taishō ajastu|eu|Taishō aroa|fa|دوره تایشو|fi|Taishō-kausi|fr|Ère Taishō|he|תקופת טאישו|hi|ताइशो युग|hu|Taisó-kor|hy|Տայսյո|id|Zaman Taishō|it|Periodo Taishō|ja|大正|ko|다이쇼 시대|lt|Taišio laikotarpis|lv|Taišo periods|ml|തായ്ഷോ കാലഘട്ടം|ms|Zaman Taishō|nl|Taishoperiode|no|Taishō-perioden|pl|Taishō (okres)|pt|Período Taishō|ro|Perioada Taishō|ru|Тайсё|sh|Taishō period|simple|Taishō era|sr|Таишо период|sv|Taishō|th|ยุคไทโช|tl|Panahong Taishō|tr|Taişo Dönemi|uk|Період Тайсьо|uz|Taishō davri|vi|Thời kỳ Đại Chính|zh|大正|zh_classical|大正 (年號)|zh_min_nan|Tāi-chèng|zh_yue|大正 (日本年號)|qid=Q329174}} 13) - Haiden rebuilt.
